title: ExteriorRender Command
description: Exterior render: the Perspective view stands outside and looks straight at the building from the north, east, south or west (north by default; from the north it looks south at the north facade), level at eye height (1.6 m) with a 24 mm lens, far enough back that the facade and the roof fit. Forsk Exterior look: materials, soft shadows, the roof shown. Saved as the named view Exterior north (and so on), replaced when asked again.

direction.description: The side the camera stands on, looking at that facade. Default north.

save.description: false: show the shot without saving the named view (the window tries a direction). Default true.
